notes_for_editor: Single-source items from Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted, paraphrased): Hally keepers and Welsford rescue, 1859-66 details, 1873 whistle and Myrick keeper dates 1886 onward, post-1920 changes, 1969 shifts, 1991, access. Keeper roster from LF only; no USLHS (Canada). Patrick Myrick's dates conflict between sources (Mistaken Point: from 1872; LF: whistle 1873, keeper 1886-97, nothing 1878-86). John Myrick matched to Cape Race by adjacency in the 1907-08 lightkeeper list OCR. Table in the 1910 report (p.81) has a garbled station column; Cape North inferred from neighbouring text and from LF/Ingenium. Tower height: 100 ft to vane (30.5 m) in the 1908 report, 29 m in the record. Titanic log is a museum transcription. Parks Canada DFHD pages returned empty; heritage text read via HistoricPlaces.ca. Marconi station end date conflicts (1930 vs marine radio until 1965). Fiscal-year labels: 'FY ended Mar 31, 1908' etc. are inferred from volume headings; the 1901 volume is for FY ended June 30, 1901 but also reports work after that date. Source budget exceeded slightly (4 searches). Staffing 'staffed as of 2012' is from LF's last keeper list; the record says staffed. Fact-check 2026-10-27: John Myrick's row in the 1907-08 lightkeepers list is row-wise OCR (name followed by station), not column-matched; page image not opened. Tower height: Mistaken Point 29 m, LF and 1909 report 30.5 m (100 ft to vane); story states the disagreement.
